task.title: Listening to auxiliary audio equipment
task.shortdesc: By connecting an optional portable audio device to the AUX input jack (stereo mini jack)

context.p: By connecting an optional portable audio device to the AUX input jack (stereo mini jack) on the unit and then simply selecting the source, you can listen on your car speakers.

step.cmd: Turn the VOLUME dial left to decrease the volume level.

info.p: The AUX volume can also be controlled separately through the connected device.

step.cmd: Turn the external audio equipment off Open the cover, connect the audio output of the external audio equipment to AUX input terminal on the unit.
Turn the external audio equipment on. Start playback of the external audio equipment at a moderate volume.
Press the AUX button to select the AUX function.
Set your usual listening volume by turn the VOLUME dial left/right on the unit.

result.p: Once the connector is disconnected, the previous mode will be restored.
AUX mode can be used only when an external audio player has been connected.
